assessments.reasoning: The Python Software Foundation's official 3.13.0 publisher source was retrieved at the registered immutable commit URL. The complete captured body and lines 808–821 match their frozen SHA-256 digests. The Expressions aclose method entry says that running its returned awaitable throws GeneratorExit at the generator's paused point and that a subsequent yielded value causes the awaitable to raise RuntimeError. Creation of the awaitable, execution of an already closed generator's aclose awaitable, generator exit, other raised exceptions, and event-loop automatic finalization are distinct documented paths. The frozen statement covers explicit closing of a suspended async generator.

limitations: This covers explicitly running the aclose awaitable on a suspended asynchronous generator. Automatic event-loop finalization has separate conditions.
